surfactantArchitecture: Sulfate-free: CAPB (2) amphoteric first, then mild anionics sulfosuccinate (3), isethionate (4), sarcosinate (9); C6 -> low.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: C6 - no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine (2), followed by the mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (3), Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate (4) and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate (9).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Three prominent mild anionics give a broad surfactant system that argues toward moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: rich architecture (W-RICH) - prominent payload lipid Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil (11) converging with four cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-10 13, Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride 20, Polyquaternium-7 21, Polyquaternium-11 22), plus Glyceryl Oleate (15) and Glycerin (26): multiple complementary systems.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone and no pearlizer; all cationic polymers sit after Parfum (12) and the coconut oil after two preservatives, so absolute levels are likely low.

weightPotential.rationale: High: W-RICH (prominent coconut oil + cationic deposition) with limited reset (resetCapacity weak, C6 low chassis) meets the rich route of the high anchor; four converging cationic polymers make cumulative residue likely.

depositionLoad.rationale: Coconut oil (11) plus four cationic polymers (13, 20, 21, 22) plus refatter; each likely at low level.

persistence.rationale: Several cationic polymers (incl. Polyquaternium-7/-10, known to accumulate) and a penetrating oil in a mild chassis are plausibly retained and cumulative.

resetCapacity.rationale: C6 mild amphoteric/mild-anionic chassis (cleansingStrength low): limited reset.

weightPotential.counterSignal: Each deposition route is listed late; no silicone.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: High: W-RICH (prominent coconut oil + cationic deposition) with limited reset (resetCapacity weak, C6 low chassis) meets the rich route of the high anchor; four converging cationic polymers make cumulative residue likely.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: the W-RICH limited-reset condition is met and multiple persistent cationic systems converge with nothing strong to remove them; calling it moderate would understate buildup risk.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: All deposition routes are late (after preservatives/Parfum), so actual load may be lower; realistic unknowns could move it to moderate.
